events.note: Query: COMMAND 10, 199, 299, 499 at 2026-01-15 04:59-05:01, and every other stellium body (301, 599, 699, 799, 899, 999, '2060;', '1;', '2;', '3;', '4;') to rule it out. In effect before the window opens, so it is reported at the first minute, 00:00 EST. Horizons at 05:00 UT: Mercury 290.968, Mars 293.642, Sun 295.045, Venus 297.080, a 6.112 degree spread, and all six pairs stay within the 8 degree conjunction orb at 04:59, 05:00 and 05:01. The clique is maximal: Vesta 301.761 is 8.119 from Mars and 10.792 from Mercury, Pluto 303.160 is 9.518 from Mars and 12.192 from Mercury, and Juno 275.972 is 21.108 from Venus. Lilith, the North Lunar Node and the Lunar Apogee are not Horizons bodies; Swiss Ephemeris puts them at 242.85, 340.00 and 238.46, over 40 degrees from Mercury. Vesta is already conjunct with Venus, the Sun and Pluto, so the conjunction component is not itself a clique: only maximal-clique detection (#1363, PR #1427) reports this one.

events.note: Query: as above, and COMMAND 10, 199, 299, 499, '4;' and 999 over 2026-01-17 17:31-17:33.
